checks: Operator password sign-in opens the requested live workspace.
Wrong typed workspace cannot submit and produces no status audit.
Missing reason is refused by the actual server with no committed change.
Detail-page suspension commits once and immediately offers reactivation.
Suspended owner retains authenticated reads; credential writes are refused with no new key.
Detail-page reactivation restores active state; both status changes correlate to customer Activity.
Workspace drawer traps keyboard focus across repeated Tab navigation.
Escape closes only the nested review and returns focus to its trigger.
Drawer suspension and reactivation both persist their advertised status once.
390px and 320px status reviews fit the viewport; Cancel returns focus without a write.
Operator without workspace-management capability cannot mutate or leave a success audit.
Invalid platform address cannot submit; reviewed settings persist after reload.
Stale settings editor is refused; reload recovers the committed version.
Platform name is restored through the actual reviewed settings action.
Offline preview and save preserve the review, explain uncertainty and create no mutation.
Retry after network recovery commits once; reactivation restores the owned workspace.
boundary: Native console status lifecycle, capability refusal, customer read/write policy, settings conflict recovery and targeted keyboard/phone acceptance. This is not a complete WCAG audit or full remaining console/support matrix.
